text: Mentalists standardly express their view as a supervenience thesis: epistemic justification ___ on the believer's mental states alone, so that any two believers alike in all mental respects are alike in justification.
explanation: The mentalist slogan is that justification supervenes on the mental: no difference in justification without a difference in mental states. This is why a subject and their mentally identical evil-demon duplicate come out equally justified, since the demon alters only external facts.
